name: @ozdna/anchor
description: ozDNA anchor cron Worker. No HTTP route: on schedule it builds a Merkle batch from pending records, submits the root via an AnchorBackend, and finalizes proofs. Binds the gas wallet ONLY (trust isolation, plan/01 §6). Pure cycle logic is repo/backend-injected + node-tested; the viem BaseAdapter is the deferred edge.
